prior_attempts.detail: The initial Playwright driver read innerText from a collapsed details element. It returned an empty string. A separate DOM read verified textContent was No current result, table placeholder was cleared and export disabled. The driver was corrected to inspect the stored record textContent, with visible table/refusal checks retained.

The next browser pass completed 23 checks then detected root-page overflow: viewport 390 pixels, document 511 pixels. A CSS-only grid minimum correction reduced it to 390 pixels. That correction was published and the complete 25-check browser journey was rerun successfully.

TinyFish run ce54e186-4dd9-440c-a4b8-3b45a0873007 could not conclusively inspect refusal/export state and confused the historical baseline record with current state. It is not treated as proof of a present failure or a complete pass. The final result comes from explicit DOM assertions and downloaded-byte verification in Playwright.

limits: Automated acceptance is not independent human usability research.
Only the public anonymous static site was tested; no private-account browser or saved-copy workflow was exercised.
One browser engine and the declared desktop/390-pixel viewport paths are not universal browser or accessibility assurance.
Model weights and published datasets were not improved by this presentation change.
